## EcclesiaOS v1.0.68

### Website Studio

- Added form widgets for testimony, prayer requests, contact, and feedback. Administrators can edit each widget's fields, text, appearance, and submission action in the section builder. Submissions are stored privately in a church-scoped inbox with assignment, status, and notes.
- Added an FAQ accordion widget, clickable Heading and Text widgets, and an option to make an entire Card clickable.
- Improved the public form presentation and the compact form widget editor.
- Added website design ZIP export and import, including pages, reusable sections, settings, and referenced uploads. Internal site links are rewritten for the destination church.
- Raised production upload and request limits to accommodate the largest supported design package and added a cross-domain transfer test.

### Deployment

- Run the included database migration for form submissions.
- Rebuild both application and web container images to apply the updated PHP and Nginx upload limits. Other deployments must configure equivalent limits.
- Review imported website content, links, and publication status before sharing the destination site.

### Verification

- Complete PHP test suite, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Pint, production frontend build, Blade and route compilation, and Git whitespace checks.
